title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Egipatska - faza 2

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja  radova na redovnom održavanju u ulici Egipatska (Novi Beograd), u periodu od 17.09. do 19.09.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Egipatska Street (Novi Beograd), in the period from 17.09. until 19.09.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na desnoj strani kolovoza u ulici Egipatska (gledano u smeru ka Surčinu), na delu od kućnog broja 1F do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Gandijeva, gledano u smeru ka Surčinu. Tokom izvođenja radova, predmetna deonica će biti zatovrena za saobraćaj, pri čemu će doći do promene u radu linija JLPP-a i to:

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the right side of the carriageway in Egipatska Street (seen in the direction of Surčin), on the part from house number 1F to the intersection zone with Gandijeva Street, seen in the direction of Surčin. During the execution of the works, the section in question will be closed to traffic, and there will be changes in the operation of the JLPP lines, namely:

sections.text: - vozila sa linija br. 45, 71, 601, 601N i 603N će u smeru ka Surčinu, saobraćati ulicama Tošin bunar, Bulevar Heroja sa Košara, Omladinskih brigada, Jurija Gagarina, Gandijeva, Vojvođanska i dalje redovnim trasama, dok u suprontom smeru će saobraćati redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 45, 71, 601, 601N and 603N in the direction of Surčin will travel on the streets Tošin bunar, Bulevar Heroja sa Košar, Omladinskih brigada, Jurija Gagarin, Gandijeva, Vojvođanska and further on regular routes, while in the opposite direction they will travel on regular routes.

sections.text: - vozila sa linija br. 82  (u skladu sa izmenom režima u vezi sa radovima u ul. Gadnijeva) će u smeru ka Surčinu, saobraćati ulicama Tošin bunar, Bulevar Heroja sa Košara, Omladinskih brigada, Jurija Gagarina, i dalje redovnim trasama, dok u suprontom smeru će saobraćati redovnim trasom.

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 82 (in accordance with the change of regime in connection with the works in Gadnijeva Street) in the direction of Surčin, will travel along the streets Tošin bunar, Bulevar Heroja sa Košar, Omladinskih brigada, Yuri Gagarin, and continue on regular routes, while in the opposite direction it will travel on the regular route.

sections.text: Vozila javnog prevoza će na izmenjenom delu koristiti sva postojeća stajališta JLPP-a.

text_translations.en: Public transport vehicles will use all existing JLPP stops on the modified section.

sections.text: Privremeno se ukida autobusko stajalište „Železnička stanica Tošin bunar“  (smer ka Surčinu) za linije br. 45, 71, 82,  601, 601N i 603N.

text_translations.en: The bus stop "Tošin Bunar Railway Station" (direction to Surčin) for lines no. 45, 71, 82, 601, 601N and 603N.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linije br. 82

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u ulicama Gandijeva i Egipatska (Novi Beograd), u periodu od 14.09. do 14.10.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza. Radovi se izvode na desnoj strani kolovoza (krajnje dve desne saobraćajne trake) u ulici Egipatska (gledano u smeru ka Surčinu), na delu od kućnog broja 1E do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Gandijeva, kao i desnoj saobraćajnoj traci ulice Gandijeva do kućnog broja 1 (gledano u smeru ka ulici Partizanske avijacije), pri čemu će biti onemogućeno korišćenje stajališta „Vojvođanska“ (#1210). Tokom izvođenja ovih radova vozila JLPP-a će se duž ulice Egipatska kretati preostalom širinom kolovoza, dok će u ulici Gandijeva leva kolovozna traka  biti udvosmerena za saobraćaj sa širinom traka od 3,2 i 2,75 metara. Zbog nedovoljne širine saobraćajnih traka za saobraćanje vozila javnog prevoza, doći će do promene u radu linije JLPP-a br. 82 i to:

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Gandijeva and Egipatska streets (New Belgrade), in the period from September 14. until 14.10.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines. The works are being carried out on the right side of the roadway (the last two right-hand traffic lanes) in Egipatska Street (seen in the direction of Surčin), on the part from house number 1E to the intersection zone with Gandijeva Street, as well as on the right traffic lane of Gandijeva Street to house number 1 (seen in the direction of Partizanske Avijacije Street), whereby the use of the "Vojvođanska" stop (#1210) will be disabled. During the execution of these works, JLPP vehicles will move along Egipatska Street with the remaining width of the roadway, while in Gandijeva Street, the left lane will be two-way for traffic with lane widths of 3.2 and 2.75 meters. Due to the insufficient width of traffic lanes for the traffic of public transport vehicles, there will be a change in the operation of JLPP line no. 82 and that:

sections.text: - vozila sa linija br. 82 će u smeru ka Bloku 44, saobraćati ulicama Tošin bunar, Egipatska, Gandijeva i dalje redovnom trasom, dok će u suprotnom smeru saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 82 in the direction of Block 44 will travel along the streets Tošin bunar, Egipatska, Gandijeva and further along the regular route, while in the opposite direction it will travel along the regular route.

sections.text: Vozila sa linije  br. 82 će na izmenjenom delu koristiti sva postojeća stajališta JLPP-a, kao i novouspostavljena privremena stajališta i to:

text_translations.en: Vehicles from line no. 82 will use all existing positions of the JLPP, as well as the newly established temporary positions, on the amended part, namely:

sections.text: - „Gandijeva 1“ ( smer ka Keju oslobođenja) u ulici Gandijeva kod kućnog broja 5, odnosno oko 25 metara ispred pešačkog pralaza koji se nalazi u zoni raskrsnice sa ulicom Egipatska.

text_translations.en: - "Gandijeva 1" (direction towards Liberation Quay) in Gandijeva Street at house number 5, that is, about 25 meters in front of the pedestrian crossing located in the area of ​​the intersection with Egipatska Street.

sections.text: Privremeno se izmešta autobusko stajlište Gadnijeva u ulici Vojvođanska na pozicju koja se nalazi ispred kućnog broja 3, odnosno oko 115 metara ispred redovne pozicije.

text_translations.en: The Gadnijeva bus stop in Vojvođanska Street is being temporarily moved to a position in front of house number 3, that is, about 115 meters in front of the regular position.

title_translations.en: Information on the change of mode of operation of line no. 82

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Kraljice Marije

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u ulici Kraljice Marije, na delu od ulaza u javnu garažu do ulaza u garažu u Studentski dom u periodu od 08.09. do 21.09. 2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Kraljice Marije Street, on the part from the entrance to the public garage to the entrance to the garage in the Student Dormitory in the period from 08.09. until 21.09. In 2026, there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju zatvaranje za saobraćaj desne saobraćajne trake ulice Kraljice Marije na delu od ulaza u javnu garažu do ulaza u garažu u Studentski dom (smer ka ulici Bulevar kralja Aleksandra) u širini od 2,5 metra.

text_translations.en: The works involve closing the right traffic lane of Kraljica Marije Street to traffic in the section from the entrance to the public garage to the entrance to the garage in the Student Dorm (direction towards Bulevar Kralja Aleksandra Street) in a width of 2.5 meters.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja predmetnih radova, ulica Kraljice Marije u visini zone radova će biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj (širina saobraćajnih traka 3,5 i 4,0 metra), pri čemu će biti onemogućeno korišćenje polazno/dolaznog stajališta „Vukov spomenik“ za linije br. 32, 66 i EKO 1.

text_translations.en: During the execution of the works in question, Kraljice Marije street at the height of the work zone will be two-way for traffic (traffic lane width 3.5 and 4.0 meters), whereby it will be impossible to use the exit/arrival stop "Vukov spomenik" for lines no. 32, 66 and ECO 1.

sections.text: Vozila sa linija br. 32 i 66 će kao dolazno stajalište koristiti stajalište „Dalmatinska“ (#551), a kao polazno „Vukov spomenik“ (#64) - oba u ulici Ruzveltova, dok će vozila sa linije EKO 1 kao dolazno koristiti postojeće „Vukov spomenik“ (#64), dok će kao polazno koristiti stajalište „Tehnički fakulteti“ (#585).

text_translations.en: Vehicles from lines no. 32 and 66 will use the "Dalmatinska" (#551) stop as the arrival stop, and "Vukov spomenik" (#64) as the departure stop - both in Ruzveltova Street, while vehicles from the EKO 1 line will use the existing "Vukov spomenik" (#64) stop as the arrival stop, while they will use the "Technical Faculties" (#585) stop as the departure stop.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Kraljice Marije Street

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linije javnog prevoza br. 76

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na izgradnji fekalne i kišne kanalizacije u ulici Autoput za Zagreb (Novi Beograd) - Faze 3 i 4 u periodu od 17.09. do 30.09.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linije javnog prevoza br. 76.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the construction of fecal and storm sewers in Autoput za Zagreb street (Novi Belgrade) - Phases 3 and 4 in the period from 17.09. until 30.09.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport line no. 76.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju iskop rova u kolovozu ulice Autoput za Zagreb na delu od benzinske pumpe „NIS Petrol“ do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Smolućska (leva strana gledano ka ulici Smolućska), pri čemu će vozila sa linije br. 76 saobraćati u oba smera ulicom Dr Žorža Matea do okretnice „Bežanijska kosa“, bez svraćanja pored JKP „Zelenilo Beograd“.

text_translations.en: The works include the digging of a trench in the roadway of the Autoput za Zagreb street in the section from the gas station "NIS Petrol" to the intersection with Smolućska Street (left side looking towards Smolućska Street), whereby vehicles from line no. 76 drive in both directions along Dr. Žorža Matea street to the "Bežanijska kosa" turnpike, without stopping by the PUK "Zelenilo Beograd".

title_translations.en: Information on the change of mode of operation of public transport line no. 76

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Geteova (Zemun)

sections.text: Radovi su produženi do 22.09.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works have been extended until September 22, 2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na asfaliranju i uređenju ulice Geteova (GO Zemun) u periodu od 17.08. do 31.08.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on asphalting and landscaping of Geteova street (GO Zemun) in the period from 17.08. until 31.08.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na kolovozu i na trotoaru, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Atanasija Pulje do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Slovenska (zatvorena raskrsnica) i podrazumevaju zatvaranje posmatrane deonice za saobraćaj, zbog čega će se vozila sa linija javnog prevoza br. 45 i 612 u oba smera kretati ulicama Rade Končara, Prvomajska (Pazovački put u smeru ka okretnici „Zemun (Novi grad)“, Geteova, Krajiška i dalje redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the roadway and on the sidewalk, in the section from the intersection zone with Atanasija Pulje Street to the intersection zone with Slovenska Street (closed intersection) and involve the closure of the observed section for traffic, which is why vehicles from public transport lines no. 45 and 612 in both directions go along the streets of Rade Končara, Prvomajska (Pazovački put in the direction of the "Zemun (Novi grad)" turnpike), Geteova, Krajiška and further on regular routes.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Geteova Street (Zemun)

title: Informacija o radovima u ulici Vojvođanska /deonica 3/ - Faza 1

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja Faze 1 radova na asfaltiranju i uređenju Ulice Vojvođanska (GO Surčin) - deonica 3, na delu od ulice Šekspirova do ulice Konstantina Danila, u periodu 16.09. do 12.10.2026. godine, doći će do izmena u funkcionisanju javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of Phase 1 of works on asphalting and landscaping of Vojvođanska Street (GO Surčin) - section 3, on the part from Šekspirova Street to Konstantina Danilo Street, in the period 16.09. until 12.10.2026. year, there will be changes in the functioning of public transport.

sections.text: Faza 1 - Tokom izvođenja radova na kolovozu u ulici Surčinska, na delu od ulice Šekspirova do ulice Konstantina Danila, doći će do zauzeća krajnje leve saobraćajne trake (gledano u smeru ka gradu) i trotoara. Vozila JLPP-a će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom širinom kolovoza uz naizmenično propuštanje regulisano privremenim semaforima i saobraćajnim znakovima.

text_translations.en: Phase 1 - During the works on the road in Surčinska Street, on the part from Šekspirova Street to Konstantina Danilo Street, the far left traffic lane (viewed in the direction of the city) and the sidewalk will be occupied. JLPP vehicles will move in the work zone on the free width of the roadway with alternating passing regulated by temporary traffic lights and traffic signs.

sections.text: Prilikom izvođenja radova u fazi 1, privremeno se izmešta autobusko stajališta i to:

text_translations.en: During the performance of works in phase 1, the bus stop is temporarily relocated, namely:

sections.text: - „Vila Mara“ (smer ka gradu) u ulici Surčinska na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 70 metara posle zone raskrnice sa ulicom Konstantina Danila, odnosno oko 190 metara posle (unapred) redovne pozicije.

text_translations.en: - "Vila Mara" (direction towards the city) in Surčinska Street to a position located about 70 meters after the intersection zone with Konstantina Danilo Street, i.e. about 190 meters after the (advance) regular position.

sections.text: - „Vila Mara“ (smer ka Jakovu) u ulici Surčinska na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 30 metara ispred zone raskrnice sa ulicom Konstantina Danila, odnosno oko 50 metara ispred (unazad) redovne pozicije.

text_translations.en: - "Vila Mara" (direction towards Jakov) in Surčinska Street to a position located about 30 meters in front of the intersection zone with Konstantina Danilo Street, i.e. about 50 meters in front (backwards) of the regular position.

title_translations.en: Information about works in Vojvođanska street /section 3/ - Phase 1

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Surčinska - Deonica 4

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na asfaliranju i uređenju ulice Surčinska (GO Novi Beograd) - deonica 4 - Faza 1 u periodu od 05.09. do 04.10.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on asphalting and landscaping of Surčinska Street (GO Novi Beograd) - section 4 - Phase 1 in the period from 05.09. until 04.10.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju zatvaranje za saobraćaj leve saobraćajne trake u ulici Surčinska (gledano u smeru ka gradu), na delu od ulice Tuluza Lorteka do ulice Valtrovićeva. Vozila JLPP-a će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom širinom kolovoza uz naizmenično propuštanje regulisano privremenim semaforima i saobraćajnim znakovima.

text_translations.en: The works involve the closure of the left traffic lane on Surčinska Street (looking towards the city), on the part from Toulouse Lorteka Street to Valtrovićeva Street. JLPP vehicles will move in the work zone on the free width of the roadway with alternating passing regulated by temporary traffic lights and traffic signs.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova, privremeno se zatvara za saobraćaj okretnica „Ledine“, pri čemu će vozila sa linija br. 71 i 603 saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: During the works, the "Ledine" turnpike is temporarily closed to traffic, whereby vehicles from line no. 71 and 603 travel as follows:

sections.text: - Vozila sa linije br. 71 će saobraćati skraćenom trasom do kružnog toka Dr Ivana Ribara, Surčinska, Vojvođanska i Auto-put Miloš Veliki, gde će vršiti promenu smera kretanja i dalje nazad prema Zelenom vencu;

text_translations.en: - Vehicles from line no. 71 will use a shortened route to the roundabout Dr. Ivan Ribara, Surčinska, Vojvođanska and Auto-put Miloš Veliki, where it will change the direction of movement and continue back towards Zeleni venc;

sections.text: - Vozila sa linije br. 603 će saobraćati produženom trasom ulicama Vojvođanska, Dr Ivana Ribara do okretnice „Novi Beograd /Blok 45/“.

text_translations.en: - Vehicles from line no. 603 will run on an extended route through the streets of Vojvođanska, Dr. Ivan Ribar to the turnpike "Novi Beograd /Blok 45/".

sections.text: Prilikom izvođenja radova u ovoj fazi, privremeno se izmeštaju autobuska stajališta:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in this phase, bus stops are temporarily relocated:

sections.text: - „Ledine“ (smer ka gradu)  - stajalište se izmešta u ulicu Surčinska, na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 10 metara ispred zone raskrnice sa ulicom Valtrovićeva, odnosno oko 90 metara ispred (unazad) redovne pozicije;

text_translations.en: - "Ledine" (direction towards the city) - the stop is moved to Surčinska Street, to a position located about 10 meters in front of the intersection zone with Valtrovićeva Street, that is, about 90 meters in front (backwards) of the regular position;

sections.text: - „Ledine“ (smer ka Jakovu)  - stajalište se izmešta u ulicu Surčinska, na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 70 metara posle zone raskrnice sa ulicom Valtrovićeva, odnosno oko 140 metara posle (unapred) redovne pozicije;

text_translations.en: - "Ledine" (direction towards Jakov) - the stop is moved to Surčinska street, to a position located about 70 meters after the intersection zone with Valtrovićeva street, i.e. about 140 meters after the (in advance) regular position;

sections.text: - „Biodekor“ (smer ka Jakovu) - stajalište se privremeno ukida.

text_translations.en: - "Biodekor" (direction to Jakov) - the stop is temporarily cancelled.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Vojvođanska

sections.text: Radovi su produženi do 31.12.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works have been extended until 31.12.2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na asfaliranju i uređenju ulice Vojvođanska - deonica 4, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Hajduk Veljkova do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Šekspirova, u periodu od 22.08. do 30.08.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog preovza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of asphalting and landscaping works on Vojvođanska Street - section 4, on the part from the intersection zone with Hajduk Veljkova Street to the intersection zone with Šekspirova Street, in the period from 22.08. until 30.08.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na kolovozu u ulici Vojvođanska, na delu od ulice Hajduk Veljkova  do ulice Desanke Maksimović, doći će do zauzeća središnjeg dela kolovoza u oba smera. Navedeni radovi neće uticati na trasu kretanje vozila JLPP-a, osim za linije 6r. 604 i 605, pošto će za saobraćaj ostati slobodna po jedna saobraćajna traka po smeru.

text_translations.en: During the works on the roadway in Vojvođanska Street, on the part from Hajduk Veljkova Street to Desanke Maksimović Street, the central part of the roadway will be occupied in both directions. The mentioned works will not affect the movement of JLPP vehicles, except for lines 6r. 604 and 605, since one traffic lane per direction will remain free for traffic.

sections.text: Istovremeno, izvodiće se radovi na kolovozu i na trotoaru ulice Vojvođanska (leva saobraćajna traka gledano u smeru ka gradu), na delu od ulice Niška do ulice Šekspirova. Vozila JLPP-a će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom širinom kolovoza uz naizmenično propuštanje regulisano privremenim semaforima i saobraćajnim znakovim.

text_translations.en: At the same time, works will be carried out on the roadway and on the sidewalk of Vojvođanska Street (the left traffic lane seen in the direction of the city), on the part from Niška Street to Šekspirova Street. JLPP vehicles will move in the work zone on the free width of the roadway with alternating passing regulated by temporary traffic lights and traffic signs.

sections.text: Prilikom izvođenja ovih radova, privremeno se izmešta autobusko stajališta:

text_translations.en: During the execution of these works, the bus stop is temporarily relocated:

sections.text: • „Novo naselje“ (smer ka Jakovu) - izmešta se u ulicu Vojvođanska, na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 15 metara ispred zone raskrnice sa ulicom Desanke Maksimović, odnosno oko 150 metara posle (unapred) redovne pozicije;

text_translations.en: • "Novo naselje" (direction towards Jakov) - moved to Vojvođanska Street, to a position located about 15 meters before the intersection with Desanke Maksimović Street, i.e. about 150 meters after (in advance) the regular position;

sections.text: • „Novo Naselje“ (smer ka gradu)  - izmešta se u ulicu Vojvođanska, na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 50 metara ispred zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Oplenačka, odnosno oko 260 metara ispred (unazad) redovne pozicije.

text_translations.en: • "Novo Naselje" (direction towards the city) - moved to Vojvođanska street, to a position located about 50 meters in front of the intersection zone with Oplenačka street, that is, about 260 meters in front (back) of the regular position.

sections.text: Vozila sa linije JLPP-a br.  604 i 605 će i dalje u oba smera, saobraćati ulicama Dr Ivana Ribara, Vinogradska, Vojvođanska, Vojvođanska u Surčinu i dalje redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: Vehicles from JLPP line no.  604 and 605 will continue to run in both directions, on the streets of Dr Ivan Ribara, Vinogradska, Vojvođanska, Vojvođanska in Surčin and on regular routes.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Vojvođanska Street

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova na produženju ulice Jurija Gagarina prema autoputu Miloš Veliki

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na produženju ulice Jurija Gagarina prema autoputu Miloš Beliki u periodu od 23.08.2026. godine do 31.03.2027. godine, doći će do promena u radu linije javnog prevoza.

sections.text:
• Tramvajske linije br. 7 i 9 će u oba smera, od zone Savskog trga saobraćati ulicama Savska, Bulevar vojvode Mišića, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Adi, Bulevar heroja sa Košara, Bulevar Crvene Armije, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Antifašističke borbe i dalje redovno do Bloka 45 i nosiće oznake 7L i 9L.
• Uspostavlja se privremena autobuska linija br. 9A (Trg Slavija - Blok 45)  koja će u intervalu od 12  minuta pokrivati deo trase kojim neće ići tramvaji (Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Milentija Popovića i Sajmište) i trasa linije 9A biće: Trg Slavija, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov most, privremena devijacija na ulicu Ušće, Ušće (Bulevar Mihajla Pupina u smeru ka gradu), Sajmište, Zemunski put, tramvajskom bašticom do ulice Milentija Popovića i dalje redovno trasama tramvajskih linija do Bloka 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 i 83 su počev od 04. oktobra zbog izvođenja pripremnih radova i oštećenja na Starom savskom mostu preusmerene na trasu Brankovim mostom i saobraćaju ulicama: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa (Admirala Geprata u smeru ka Banjici odnosno Crvenom krstu), Pop Lukina, Brankov most, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i dalje redovno do Zemuna. 
• Vozila će na izmenjenim delovima trasa koristiti postojeća kao i novouspostavljena privremena stajališta „Kamenička 1“ i „Brankov most 1“ za linije br. 9A, 78 i 83 - smer prema Trgu Slavija, odnosno „Staro sajmište“ - smer prema Bloku 45 za liniju br. 9A.

text_translations.en:
• Tram lines no. 7 and 9 will run in both directions, from the area of ​​Sava Square, through the streets of Savska, Bulevar Vojvode Mišić, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Ada, Bulevar Herojas sa Košar, Bulevar Crvena Armija, Bulevar Milutin Milankovića, Bulevar Antifascistke Borbe and continue regularly to Block 45 and will carry signs 7L and 9L.
• A temporary bus line no. 9A (Trg Slavija - Block 45), which will cover the part of the route on which trams will not run (Milutin Milanković Boulevard, Milentija Popovića and Sajmište) and the route of line 9A will be: Slavija Square, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, temporary deviation to Ušće Street, Ušće (Mihajla Pupina Boulevard in the direction of the city), Sajmište, Zemunski put, by tram garden to Milentija Popovića Street and further by regular tram routes to Block 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 and 83 have been diverted since October 4 due to preparatory works and damage to the Old Sava Bridge to the Brankov Most route and traffic on the streets: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrilo Principa (Admiral Geprato in the direction of Banjica, i.e. the Red Cross), Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and further regularly to Zemun. 
• Vehicles will use the existing as well as the newly established temporary stops "Kamenička 1" and "Brankov most 1" for lines no. 9A, 78 and 83 - direction towards Trg Slavija, i.e. "Staro sajmište" - direction towards Block 45 for line no. 9A.

sections.text: Faza 4 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Somborska (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu) do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Ugrinovačka. text_translations.en: Phase 4 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Somborska Street (including the intersection itself) to the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 07.05. until 27.05.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 4a - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Somborska (slobodna raskrsnica) do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Ugrinovačka. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 28.05. do 12.06.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 4a - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic on the part from the intersection zone with Somborska Street (free intersection) to the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 28.05. until 12.06.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 3 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Niška do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Somborska. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 13.06. do 15.07.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 3 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street for traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Niška Street to the intersection zone with Somborska Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 13.06. until 15.07.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 2a - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Cara Dušana do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Niška (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu). text_translations.en: Phase 2a - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Cara Dušana Street to the intersection zone with Niška Street (including the intersection itself). text_translations.en: Phase 2 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Cara Dušana Street to the intersection zone with Niška Street (free intersection).
